python3 -c "
import os, sys
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    try:
        os.setsid()
        os.write(2, b'child setsid OK\n')
    except OSError as e:
        os.write(2, ('child setsid FAIL %s\n' % e).encode())
    os._exit(0)
os.waitpid(pid, 0)
